entries.odia: ଜାଣିଥିଲିକି? କିଏ ସୂନା କିଏ ପିତଳ ବୋଲି ନିକିତି ପକେଇ ତୁଳି ଥିଲିକି?
entries.title: Had I weighed them?
entries.literal_meaning: Did I know? Had I put them on a balance and weighed who was gold and who was brass?
entries.explanation: Two questions resist the expectation of prior knowledge. Gold and brass give the contrast a material image, while the balance suggests examination. Our reading hears someone explaining a mistaken judgment: they had not tested what they were asked to recognise. The source supplies no particular deception, person or transaction.
entries.meaning_odia: ଦୁଇଟି ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ ଆଗରୁ ଜାଣିଥିବାର ଆଶାକୁ ଅଟକାଏ। ସୁନା ଓ ପିତଳ ବିରୋଧକୁ ବସ୍ତୁର ଛବି ଦିଏ, ନିକିତି ପରଖିବାକୁ ମନେ ପକାଏ। ଆମ ପଢ଼ାରେ ଭୁଲ ବିଚାରର ସଫେଇ ଶୁଣାଯାଏ—ଯାହାକୁ ଚିହ୍ନିବା ଆଶା କରାଗଲା, ତାକୁ ପରଖାଯାଇନଥିଲା। ଉତ୍ସ କୌଣସି ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ ଠକାମି, ମଣିଷ ବା କାରବାର ଦିଏନାହିଁ।
entries.english_summary: Our reading hears a defence against being expected to know without examining.
entries.odia_summary: ନ ପରଖି ଜାଣିବାର ଆଶା ବିରୋଧରେ ଆମ ପଢ଼ାର ସଫେଇ।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: ଜଣେ ଶୁଣିଥିବା ଖବର ଆଗକୁ କହିଦେଲେ; ପରେ ତାହା ଭୁଲ ବୋଲି ଜଣାଗଲା। ସେ ଢଗଟି ମନେ ପକାଇ କହିଲେ, “ଆଗରୁ ପରଖିନଥିଲି; ଏବେ ସଂଶୋଧନଟି ମଧ୍ୟ ଜଣାଇବି।” / Someone passes on a report that proves false. Recalling the saying, they admit, “I had not checked it; now I will pass on the correction too.” This response is invented.
entries.cultural_context: The balance is a source image, not evidence that weighing alone identifies metal composition. The interpretation establishes no hierarchy of human worth.

entries.title: The scrupulous woman
entries.literal_meaning: The scrupulous elder sister is applying cow-dung water to her body.
entries.explanation: The dictionary explicitly calls the address ironic and describes excessive observance of purity. The bodily action gives that irony a concrete image. Our reading asks how a claim to scrupulousness can become an object of ridicule, without accepting the ridicule as evidence about women or a whole tradition.
entries.meaning_odia: ଅଭିଧାନ ସମ୍ବୋଧନଟିକୁ ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ ବ୍ୟଙ୍ଗ୍ୟ ବୋଲି କହି ଅତିରିକ୍ତ ଆଚାରନିଷ୍ଠାର ଅର୍ଥ ଦିଏ। ଦେହରେ ଲଗାଇବାର କାମ ସେ ବ୍ୟଙ୍ଗ୍ୟକୁ ଏକ ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ ଛବି ଦିଏ। ଆମ ପଢ଼ାରେ ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ ଉଠେ—ଅତି ସତର୍କ ଆଚାରର ଦାବି କିପରି ପରିହାସର ବିଷୟ ହୁଏ? ସେ ପରିହାସକୁ ନାରୀ ବା ସମଗ୍ର ପରମ୍ପରା ବିଷୟରେ ପ୍ରମାଣ କରାଯାଇନାହିଁ।
entries.english_summary: An explicitly ironic address places scrupulous purity under ridicule.
entries.odia_summary: ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ ବ୍ୟଙ୍ଗ୍ୟ ସମ୍ବୋଧନରେ ଅତିରିକ୍ତ ଆଚାରନିଷ୍ଠା ପରିହାସର ବିଷୟ।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: ପଢ଼ାଚକ୍ରରେ ଜଣେ ପଚାରିଲେ, “କଥାଟି କାହାର ନିୟମକୁ ହସୁଛି, ଆଉ କାହାକୁ ନିଶାନା କରୁଛି?” ଅନ୍ୟଜଣ କହିଲେ, “ବ୍ୟଙ୍ଗ୍ୟଟିକୁ ପଢ଼ିବା, କିନ୍ତୁ ସବୁ ନାରୀଙ୍କ ବିଚାର କରିବା ନୁହେଁ।” / A reading group asks whose rules and whose person the joke targets. Someone replies, “We can read its irony without making a judgment about all women.” This discussion is invented.
entries.cultural_context: The feminine address and historical register are retained. The saying does not document a named practitioner, present prevalence, clinical condition or safe cleansing method.

entries.title: Expecting kindness from the cat
entries.literal_meaning: The tomcat eating its own young: an analogy.
entries.explanation: The dictionary explains the analogy as vainly expecting kindness toward another’s young from a cat that eats its own. The contrast concerns what one expects after the conduct already imagined. Our reading asks what grounds there are for trust; the premise is retained as the source’s analogy, not offered as a general fact about cats or a rule that people cannot change.
entries.meaning_odia: ଅଭିଧାନ ଉପମାଟିକୁ ଏପରି ବୁଝାଏ—ନିଜ ଛୁଆ ଖାଉଥିବା ଭୁଆଠାରୁ ପର ଛୁଆ ପ୍ରତି ମମତା ଆଶା କରିବା ଦୁରାଶା। କଳ୍ପିତ ଆଚରଣଟି ଦେଖିସାରି କଣ ଆଶା କରାଯାଉଛି, ସେହି ବିରୋଧ ମୁଖ୍ୟ। ଆମ ପଢ଼ାରେ ଭରସାର ଆଧାର ନେଇ ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ ଅଛି। ମୂଳ ଧାରଣାଟି ଉତ୍ସର ଉପମା ଭାବେ ରହେ, ବିରାଡ଼ି ବିଷୟରେ ସାଧାରଣ ତଥ୍ୟ ବା ମଣିଷ ବଦଳିପାରେନାହିଁ ବୋଲି ନିୟମ ହୁଏନାହିଁ।
entries.english_summary: Our reading asks what supports an expectation of kindness.
entries.odia_summary: ମମତାର ଆଶାକୁ କେଉଁ ଆଧାର ସମର୍ଥନ କରୁଛି—ଆମ ପଢ଼ାର ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: ଏକ ଆଲୋଚନାରେ ଜଣେ ଭରସା ଚାହୁଁଥିବା ସଂସ୍ଥାର ପୂର୍ବ ଅଙ୍ଗୀକାର ଭଙ୍ଗ କଥା ଉଠାଇଲେ। ଅନ୍ୟଜଣ ଉପମାଟି ମନେ ପକାଇ କହିଲେ, “ବଦଳିଥିବାର ପ୍ରମାଣ କଣ, ସେଥି ଦେଖିବା।” / A group considers trusting an organisation that previously broke commitments. Someone recalls the analogy: “Let us look for evidence that it has changed.” The application is invented and does not declare change impossible.
entries.cultural_context: This is a documented analogy headed nyaya, not a reconstructed verse or folktale. No particular animal, human incident, original author or zoological observation is established.

entries.odia: ଭଇଁରା ଗାଁରେ ପୁରାଣ ସଭା ଶୁଣିଲା ଲୋକେ ହୋଇବେ କାବା
entries.title: Who is listening?
entries.literal_meaning: A Purana gathering in a deaf village: those who hear will be astonished.
entries.explanation: The line places a listening gathering in a village called deaf, then turns to those who hear. That tension carries the joke. Our critical reading asks about the assumed audience and the means of participation, rather than treating deafness as a lack of intelligence or interest. The source supplies no actual village or performance.
entries.meaning_odia: ଶୁଣିବାର ସଭାକୁ କାଲ ବୋଲି କୁହାଯାଇଥିବା ଗାଁରେ ରଖି, କଥାଟି ପୁଣି ଶୁଣିଥିବା ଲୋକଙ୍କ ଆଡ଼କୁ ଫେରେ। ଏହି ଟାଣାପଡ଼ାରେ ପରିହାସ ରହେ। ଆମ ସମାଲୋଚନାତ୍ମକ ପଢ଼ା ଧରିନିଆଯାଇଥିବା ଶ୍ରୋତା ଓ ଭାଗ ନେବାର ଉପାୟକୁ ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ କରେ; ବଧିରତାକୁ ବୁଦ୍ଧି ବା ଆଗ୍ରହର ଅଭାବ ମାନେନାହିଁ। ଉତ୍ସ କୌଣସି ପ୍ରକୃତ ଗାଁ ବା ପ୍ରଦର୍ଶନ ଦିଏନାହିଁ।
entries.english_summary: Our critical reading questions the audience assumed by the joke.
entries.odia_summary: ପରିହାସରେ ଧରିନିଆଯାଇଥିବା ଶ୍ରୋତାକୁ ଆମ ପଢ଼ା ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ କରେ।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: ଏକ ପାଠ ଆଲୋଚନାରେ ଢଗଟି ପଢ଼ି ଜଣେ କହିଲେ, “ସଭାରେ କିଏ ଭାଗ ନେଇପାରିବ, ଆଗରୁ କାହିଁକି ଧରିନେବା? ଲେଖା ବା ଅନ୍ୟ ଉପାୟ ରଖିପାରିବା।” / After reading the line, a group member asks why participation should be assumed in advance and suggests providing written material too. This response is invented, not the saying’s traditional lesson.
entries.cultural_context: Sambalpur is the dictionary’s label for the adjective, not verified origin of the saying. Exact quotation spelling is preserved; duplicated head blocks contain only one labelled saying.
